mipnerf360/bicycle.text: Tip: Look at the brick building above the hedge at top right, which MeshSplatting erases into white sky.

mipnerf360/flowers.text: Tip: Look at the small conifer at top left, whose pointed top 2DGS rounds off into a dome.

mipnerf360/garden.text: Tip: Look at the lawn behind the table's right side, where Hexels keep slightly crisper grass blades than 2DGS.

mipnerf360/stump.text: Tip: Look at the thin weed stalk in the grass at the right edge, which 2DGS nearly erases.

mipnerf360/treehill.text: Tip: Look at the railing just right of the stone wall, where 2DGS drops a stretch of the top rail.

mipnerf360/room.text: Tip: Look at the dark rim atop the tall white cylinder at top right, which 2DGS breaks in two.

mipnerf360/counter.text: Tip: Look at the floor tiles in the bottom-left corner, where 2DGS smooths away the grout lines.

mipnerf360/kitchen.text: Tip: Look at the placemat right of the bulldozer's bucket, which MeshSplatting covers with large dark triangles.

mipnerf360/bonsai.text: Tip: Look at the lower fold of the purple cloth, where 2DGS adds pale needle-like streaks.

tanks_and_temples/Train.text: Tip: Look at the shaded gravel in the foreground, where Hexels keep individual stones that 2DGS smooths into a flat sheet.

tanks_and_temples/Truck.text: Tip: Look at the turquoise hood, clean in Hexels but briefly crossed by dark streak floaters in Triangle Splatting.

tanks_and_temples/Francis.text: Tip: Look at the top of the monument, where a pale 2DGS floater slices diagonally through the cornice beside the left eagle.

tanks_and_temples/Horse.text: Tip: Look at the white tower behind the horse: Hexels keep its roof, which 2DGS dissolves into the sky.

tanks_and_temples/Lighthouse.text: Tip: Look at the tree under the gable's left eave, where a bright white 2DGS floater covers much of its crown.

tanks_and_temples/Barn.text: Tip: Look at the sky just above the roof's right half, where Triangle Splatting leaves a thin dark streak floater.

tanks_and_temples/Caterpillar.text: Tip: Look at the sky above the trees right of the cab, where 2DGS shows a dark blue floater.

tanks_and_temples/Courthouse.text: Tip: Look at the dome above the roofline: Hexels keep it, while 2DGS loses it in the sky.

tanks_and_temples/Ignatius.text: Tip: Look at the conifer above the roof at the top right, whose upper part 2DGS loses in the sky.

tanks_and_temples/Meetingroom.text: Tip: Look through the far-left windows: Hexels show the trees and house outside, which 2DGS washes into a pale haze.

dtu/scan24.text: Tip: Look at the golden top of the clock tower, where 2DGS adds a glowing yellow-green blob.

dtu/scan37.text: Tip: Look at the white label on the red handle, where Hexels keep the printed digits that 2DGS blurs away.

dtu/scan40.text: Tip: Look just above the top stone block, where 2DGS adds a large gray clump of debris.

dtu/scan55.text: Tip: Look just right of the bunny's ears, where 2DGS adds brown leaf-like floaters.

dtu/scan63.text: Tip: Look at the pumpkin's stem, which Triangle Splatting cuts with a dark vertical sliver.

dtu/scan65.text: Tip: Look at the far right end of the table's back edge, which 2DGS cuts off with a dark wedge.

dtu/scan69.text: Tip: Look left of the middle snowman's top hat, where 2DGS adds a brown flaky floater.

dtu/scan83.text: Tip: Look at the orange bar at the left edge, which 2DGS loses except for a short stub at its upper end.

dtu/scan97.text: Tip: Look at the table right of the white bag, which 2DGS covers with a dark floater streaked red and green.

dtu/scan105.text: Tip: Look at the table corner right of the plush toy, which 2DGS cuts off with a black wedge.

dtu/scan106.text: Tip: Look at the end of the wooden table left of the two birds, which 2DGS replaces with black and a teal band.

dtu/scan110.text: Tip: Look at the table at the lower left, where 2DGS adds a glowing white blob with pink streaks.

dtu/scan114.text: Tip: Look at the table's end left of the Buddha, which 2DGS cuts off with a black wedge and a blue-green streak.

dtu/scan118.text: Tip: Look at the table's right end, where 2DGS leaves a dark gap with a green line, a green blob and a magenta streak.

dtu/scan122.text: Tip: Look at the dark background left of the owl's head, where 2DGS shows a bright white floater.

mipnerf360/garden.3dgs: Tip: Drag the crosshair over the football under the table: Hexel primitives follow its panels, 3DGS uses soft blobs.
mipnerf360/garden.2dgs: Tip: Drag the crosshair over the football under the table: Hexel primitives follow its panels, 2DGS uses soft blobs.

mipnerf360/bicycle.3dgs: Tip: Drag the crosshair over the front wheel: Hexels draw the spokes as long thin strips, unlike 3DGS.

mipnerf360/counter.3dgs: Tip: On the floor at the far left, Hexels keep a grout line and crumb that 3DGS smooths away.

dtu/scan24.3dgs: Tip: Look at the gray roof at the lower left, where 3DGS leaves a bright white streak.

quad.dtu/scan65: Tip: Drag the crosshair over the top of the skull: Hexel primitives tile it with large, crisp-edged polygons.
